title: Old versus modern drumming style and tuning
summary: Foster compares old drumming with today's: beat patterns, cymbals, rolls, crisp snare and tuning the bass drum.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
